description: A ranked list of AI receptionists with each vendor's cost at 100 and 200 calls a month (3-minute calls), plan limit, billing model, contract, trial, spam billing, verified integrations and the score with its breakdown. Defaults to the overall list. Accepts a slug from list_rankings (for example "best-ai-receptionist-for-law-firms"). Source: AI Receptionist Rankings, data read from vendor pages, https://www.aireceptionistrankings.com/

list.description: List slug, e.g. "best-ai-receptionist-for-law-firms"; defaults to the overall ranking

name: get_rankings
title: Get a ranked list
